nl: In config/deploy.yaml, replace the exact text `image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0` with `image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.1`. Change nothing else.

entries.content_utf8:
# Database settings
[database]
url = "postgres://db.example.com:5432/orders"
pool_size = 10
timeout_seconds = 30

[database.replica]
url = "postgres://replica.example.com:5432/orders"
enabled = false

service: orders
replicas: 2
image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0
resources:
  memory: 512Mi
  cpu: 500m
env:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  REGION: eu-central

[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080
debug = true

[mail]
sender = orders@example.com
smtp = smtp.example.com

config/deploy.yaml.text:
service: orders
replicas: 2
image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.1
resources:
  memory: 512Mi
  cpu: 500m
env:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  REGION: eu-central

oracle_program: replace "image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0" "image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.1" in: ["config/deploy.yaml"] mode: literal expect: 1
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('config/deploy.yaml')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = 'image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.1').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'config/deploy.yaml'
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$old = 'image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0'
$new = 'image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.1'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($old))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'expected one match' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($old, $new))
